resharper_csharp_new_line_before_while #

A new line before a do statement's while. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-30 and fully symmetric: at true the oracle puts while (b); on its own line FLUSH WITH THE do, inserting the break if the author did not write one; at false it joins. Skala kept the break and indented the while four columns, because a do's trailing while has no clause node of its own — else, catch and finally are each the first token of a clause and are units, and this keyword sits directly in DoStatementSyntax, so the continuation walk read it as a continuation of the do. Fixed in StartsAUnit.

Typetrue / false
Defaultfalse
Default known froman oracle probe — jb cleanupcode under a configuration carrying nothing but root = true, compared against the fixture that exercises the key
TierA — the formatter reads it and a committed oracle fixture pins it
Languagecsharp
Since0.1
